answer_to_user: Here are large companies whose bottom-line profit (net income) has risen in each of the last several years — i.e. they keep making more money year after year. "Making more money every year" here means the annual profit figure went UP every year, not just on average — so it filters out one-off spikes followed by a drop. The list is full of recognizable names: Nvidia (NVDA), Alphabet/Google (GOOG), Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN), TSMC (2330), Samsung Electronics (005930), Eli Lilly (LLY), Walmart (WMT), Visa (V) and AMD. A rising profit trend is a good sign of a healthy, growing business, but note some of these (like Nvidia) grew from a chip/AI boom that may not repeat at the same pace, so past growth isn't a promise of future growth. Informational only — not advice to buy.
